errors.evidence: In the description of the 'hard' chart, the values for the 'N+K+' and 'N-K+' categories are swapped. The figure shows that 'N+K+' is 20.1% and 'N-K+' is 36.2%.

errors.text_span: The segments within each chart appear to be arranged in descending order of size.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The slices within the pie charts are not arranged sequentially in descending order of size. For instance, in the 'easy' chart, moving clockwise from the top, the slices are 40.6%, 3.3%, 10.1%, and 45.9%, which is not an ordered sequence.
